insights.headline: Gold at a one-year low as Fed hike bets lift the dollar; silver slides 5% on MCX
insights.summary: Spot gold touched $3,830 an ounce, its lowest in over a year, and MCX silver slid 5.14% to Rs 1,67,239 per kg as bets on a December Fed rate hike pushed the dollar to its strongest since April 2025 and 10-year Treasury yields above 5%. MCX gold recovered some losses to Rs 1,35,801 per 10 g after an intraday low of Rs 1,34,385. Traders now look to the Fed's December 9 decision, with a quarter-point hike fully priced in.
points: Spot gold hit $3,830.74, its lowest since October 2, 2025, and is down 31.5% from January's record $5,594.82 high.
MCX silver fell 5.14% to Rs 1,67,239 per kg after touching Rs 1,66,650; gold ended at Rs 1,35,801 per 10 g.
Gold has fallen 15.1% in 12 weeks, its fifth-steepest such drop in 20 years, BullionVault notes.
A December Fed hike of 25 basis points is fully expected, with about a 10% chance of a 50-point move.
The Silver Institute expects total silver demand to fall 5% in 2026, with industrial demand down 3%.

trending.title: MCX metals end a brutal Monday near their lows
trending.summary: MCX December silver closed 5.14% lower at Rs 1,67,239 per kg after a low of Rs 1,66,650, while gold recovered to Rs 1,35,801 per 10 g after touching Rs 1,34,385.

trending.title: Gold sinks to a one-year low, worst year since 2015
trending.summary: Spot gold hit $3,830.74, its lowest since October 2, 2025, and is down 31.5% from January's record $5,594.82 high; BullionVault notes a 15.1% fall in 12 weeks, the fifth-steepest in 20 years.

trending.title: Fed hike bets and a 19-month-high dollar cap bullion
trending.summary: Markets fully expect a 25-basis-point December Fed hike, with about a 10% chance of a larger move, as the dollar holds near its strongest since April 2025 and 10-year yields stay above 5%.

trending.title: Silver demand softens even as supply stays short
trending.summary: Silver demand is seen falling 5% in 2026 as jewellery demand contracts and solar makers use less of the metal, though a 35-million-ounce deficit persists and BofA sees a $70 average in 2027.

trending.title: Festive demand holds up as jewellers report records
trending.summary: Senco Gold's Dhanteras sales hit a record Rs 2,426 crore, up 26%, and Titan's profit more than doubled as lower prices drew buyers back, even as jewellers' margins stayed mixed.

items.title: Silver slides below ₹1.69 lakh as Fed rate fears hit bullion. Could prices fall further?
items.summary: MCX silver fell 5.14% to Rs 1,67,239 per kg in evening trade after touching Rs 1,66,650, while December gold recovered some losses to Rs 1,35,801 per 10 g after an intraday low of Rs 1,34,385. The Silver Institute expects total silver demand to fall 5% in 2026, with industrial demand down 3%, even as a 35-million-ounce supply deficit persists.

items.title: Gold sinks to 1-year low as Treasury yields and dollar bite, set for worst year since 2015
items.summary: Gold hit $3,830.74 an ounce, its lowest since October 2, 2025, and is down 31.5% from January's record high of $5,594.82, putting it on course for its worst year since 2015. High Treasury yields, a dollar near its strongest since April 2025 and expectations of a December Fed hike are weighing on bullion, though physically backed gold ETFs still drew 211 tonnes in the third quarter.

items.title: MCX gold falls 2% to record low at ₹1.34 lakh/10 gms, silver tumbles 4% amid growing bets of Fed rate hike
items.summary: MCX December gold fell as much as 1.7% to a fresh intraday low of Rs 1,34,385 per 10 g, while silver slid 4% to a record low of Rs 1,69,194 per kg. COMEX December gold hit a fresh 52-week low of $3,835.20 an ounce and silver $47.07. Markets price a 92% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December.

items.title: Gold falls to Rs 1.33 lakh, silver under Rs 1.70 lakh as sell-off deepens in precious metal prices
items.summary: Gold has fallen 5.7% since November 9 to Rs 1,33,797 per 10 g and silver 8.8% to Rs 1,69,591 per kg, with global gold near $3,800 an ounce and silver near $47, both one-year lows, as a strong dollar, rising Treasury yields and 92% odds of a December Fed hike weigh on bullion.

items.title: Silver prices crash by Rs 7,000; dollar strength, rate hike prospects weigh
items.summary: Silver fell Rs 7,115 per kg to Rs 1,69,194 on MCX as the dollar index hovered near a 19-month high around 103.44. Stronger-than-expected US inflation, with consumer prices up 0.4% in October, has investors pricing in a higher chance of further Fed rate rises, while rising Treasury yields lift the cost of holding silver.

items.title: Silver ETFs Crash 5%: What's The Bearish Demand Forecast That Triggered Selloff
items.summary: Silver ETFs fell nearly 5%, with the SBI Silver ETF down 4.76% to Rs 165.20 in its biggest fall since September 26, after Metals Focus forecast global silver demand down 5% in 2026, with jewellery demand contracting about 5% even as industrial demand is set to rise 1% to a record 710 million ounces.

items.title: Gold price slides as Fed hike bets rise, silver bar and coin sales drop despite lower prices – Heraeus
items.summary: Gold fell back below $4,000 an ounce after October CPI rose 0.4% month on month, above the 0.3% expected, with core inflation up 0.3% for a third month. Heraeus notes a 25-basis-point December hike is now fully expected, with about a 10% chance of a 50-point move. Silver dropped below $47, and Perth Mint silver sales fell 36% in October despite the lower price.

items.title: 'Plenty of Reasons to Sell' as Gold Sinks 15% in 12 Weeks
items.summary: Gold has fallen 15.1% over the 12 weeks to 13 November, its fifth-steepest 12-week drop in 20 years and the most persistent of the five, with prices down in 10 of the 12 weeks. Spot gold slid to $3,833 early on Monday, a 13-month low, as US rate-hike expectations held the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% and the dollar near its strongest since April 2025.

items.title: From Above Rs 4 Lakh To Below Rs 1.75 Lakh: Why Silver Prices Have Fallen So Sharply
items.summary: MCX silver has fallen nearly 60% from the Rs 4 lakh per kg peak first breached in January to Rs 1.69 lakh, with COMEX silver at a new 52-week low near $47.22 an ounce. A stronger dollar, elevated bond yields, ETF outflows and weaker industrial demand, including slower AI and solar demand, are behind the slide, analysts say.

items.title: India bought 29% less gold last quarter. So how did Titan and Kalyan grow over 20%?
items.summary: India's gold demand fell 29% by weight to 162.5 tonnes in July-September as record prices curbed buying, the World Gold Council said, yet Titan's domestic jewellery revenue rose 21% and Kalyan's India revenue 27% as higher prices lifted sales value. Titan's profit more than doubled to Rs 2,393 crore and Kalyan's rose 64%, helped by recycled gold and lighter jewellery.

items.title: Senco Gold reports record ₹2,426 crore Dhanteras sales, up 26%; retail revenue rises 25%
items.summary: Senco Gold posted record festive-season retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore between 1 October and 11 November, up 26% on last year, despite volatile and elevated gold prices. Retail revenue rose 25%, and the jeweller crossed ₹10,000 crore in sales on a trailing 12-month basis. The company credited higher footfalls, new customers and its Dhanteras campaign.

items.title: Silver prices find $50 floor as solar industry seeks to accelerate shift toward copper
items.summary: Metals Focus sees silver holding a floor near $50 an ounce after its retreat from January's record $121.65, though it warns prices can still dip below that level. The Silver Institute and Metals Focus expect a sixth straight annual deficit in 2026, with demand beating supply by 35 million ounces, while solar makers speed a shift to copper to cut silver use.

items.title: Rupee rises 27 paise to close at 93.92 against US dollar
items.summary: The rupee rose 27 paise to close at 93.92 per dollar on Monday, snapping a two-day decline, as foreign fund inflows, a rally in domestic equities and softer crude oil prices supported the currency. Foreign investors have bought nearly $10 billion of Indian shares in November, while the dollar index stayed near a 19-month high at 103.44.

items.title: Gold Stays Weak As Persistent Inflation Supports Higher Rate Expectations
items.summary: Gold consolidated near $3,850, at the lower edge of its $3,850-$4,000 support zone, after falling from above $5,300 in January, as persistent US inflation kept December Fed hike bets near 91%. Fed officials signalled gradual hikes with inflation still too hot, and Iran said it carried out drone attacks on a US facility in Bahrain. Traders await Fed Chair Warsh's remarks later on Monday.

items.title: Silver’s Correction: Is $48 the Launchpad for the Next Bullish Move?
items.summary: Silver has fallen below $48 an ounce for the first time in about a year as Fed rate-hike bets and a strong dollar pressure the metal, and this analysis asks whether $48 can serve as a launchpad for the next move rather than the start of a deeper slide.

items.title: Precious Metals Crash: Silver falls Rs 5,000, gold drops nearly 1%; What's triggering the sell-off?
items.summary: MCX silver fell Rs 5,460 (3.1%) to Rs 1,70,849 per kg and gold slipped Rs 977 to Rs 1,35,728 per 10 g in Monday trade, as hawkish Fed signals and a likely December rate hike weighed on bullion; spot gold held near $3,900 and silver below $48.

items.title: Goldman's second gold forecast downgrade in a month turns its bear case into the base case
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its end-2027 gold forecast to $4,650 an ounce from $4,800, its second cut in a month, and now expects a third Fed hike in March 2027 after December's. The bank still sees about 16% upside by December 2027 on central-bank buying of around 60 tonnes a month, but warns ETF investors could sell into the weakness.

items.title: Gold prices drop 4.1% to Rs 1.36 lakh, silver slides nearly 5% to Rs 1.76 lakh on MCX
items.summary: December gold futures fell Rs 5,847, or 4.1%, to Rs 1.36 lakh per 10 g this week, while silver slid Rs 8,791, nearly 5%, to Rs 1.76 lakh per kg. COMEX gold dropped almost 5% to $3,886 an ounce and silver 5.4% to $49.12, as a firm dollar and rising yields kept December Fed hike bets alive. Analysts expect volatility ahead, with inflation data, FOMC minutes and US jobs figures due.

items.title: Banking giant sets silver price for 2027
items.summary: Bank of America expects silver to average $70 an ounce in 2027, reaching $75 in the second and third quarters, while JPMorgan sees a $63 average and the World Bank $62. Silver was trading near $47, down about 3% on the week and well below its January record of $121.

items.title: Fed 'has some work to do on inflation,' KC Fed chief says
items.summary: Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said on Sunday that US inflation is 'uncomfortably above' the 2% target and moving in the wrong direction, and that the Fed has the tools and the responsibility to bring it down. He did not call for more hikes outright, but rate futures are now fully priced for a quarter-point rise at the December meeting, with a small chance of a half-point move.

items.title: Silver: Rebound faces renewed selling pressure – OCBC
items.summary: OCBC says silver's post-midterms rebound proved short-lived, with prices slipping below $50 and falling about 6% over the week as elevated US yields, a firm dollar and Fed tightening expectations weighed. The silver market is set for a sixth straight annual supply deficit in 2026, but it is narrowing to 35 million ounces from 54 million, with total demand forecast down 5%.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: Silver Slides Below $50 as Treasury Yields Jump
items.summary: Spot silver closed the week at $48.77, down 6.1%, after hot US producer inflation lifted December Fed hike bets, the dollar and Treasury yields. FXEmpire notes the 10-year yield rose to 5.16% and markets price an 88% chance of a December hike, while the Silver Institute expects demand to fall 5% this year. A break below $48 could open the way to $44–$45, the analysis says.

items.title: Gold prices boost jewellers' sales, but profits tell a mixed story
items.summary: Record gold prices lifted jewellers' revenues but squeezed margins in the September quarter: Thangamayil's revenue rose 40% to Rs 2,381 crore while profit was flat, Titan's jewellery margin was 11.1% after a Rs 490 crore customs-duty gain, and Kalyan's profit rose 64% to Rs 427 crore. Titan is expanding 18-carat jewellery and Kalyan sees more exchange-led purchases.

items.title: Why solar researchers are working to devise a silver reduction playbook
items.summary: Silver paste used for the contacts in solar cells made up as much as 30% of a cell's manufacturing cost when silver prices peaked in early 2026. Researchers at UNSW Sydney are working on ways to use less silver, or replace it altogether, without losing efficiency or durability, as rising prices and supply worries push makers to find alternatives.

items.title: Titan shifts focus to buyer growth as gold-price gains become less reliable
items.summary: Titan plans to widen its jewellery customer base with more affordable pieces below Rs 1 lakh, as it expects gold-price gains to stop lifting ticket sizes. Buyer growth in its Tanishq, Mia and Zoya division was flat in Q2 FY27 against 5% in Q1, and its managing director said stable or lower gold prices could bring back customers who had stayed away.

items.title: SGB 2018-19 III delivers 348% return: Rs 1 lakh grows to Rs 4.48 lakh
items.summary: Sovereign Gold Bond 2018-19 Series III matured on November 13 at an RBI-fixed redemption price of Rs 14,024 per gram, turning Rs 1 lakh invested at Rs 3,133 a gram in 2018 into about Rs 4.48 lakh, a 348% gain before the 2.5% annual interest. Capital gains on maturity are tax-exempt; the government has stopped fresh SGB issues for now.

items.title: US Dollar Just Hit a 19-Month High - Here's What It Means for Gold and Silver
items.summary: The US dollar index has hit a 19-month high near 103.44, and this piece sets out what a strong dollar means for gold and silver, which have both slid as markets price a December Fed rate hike.
